caption: A lamp with a coloured shade is switched on, and the shade glows while the desk below is lit through its open bottom.

sa.check: A lamp has a coloured shade.
The desk below is lit through the open bottom.
The brightest spot is directly beneath the shade.

pc.expect: The shade glows evenly with the bulb inside and the brightest spot is directly beneath.
pc.fail: The shade stays dark with the lamp on; or the brightest spot is far to one side; or the desk stays dark.

pc.expect: The glow through the shade is the shade's colour and the desk below is lit whiter.
pc.fail: The shade glows a different colour; or the desk is the shade's colour; or the glow changes colour.

pc.expect: The light would stop when the lamp is off and the lit area stays put.
pc.fail: The shade glows with the lamp off; or the lit area wanders; or flickers.

pc.expect: The lit area below is a round pool.
pc.fail: It is a sharp square; or splits; or is on the ceiling only.
A second lamp appears; or it vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The desk and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The desk changes; or the room rearranges; or the shade changes shape.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
